extracted.intended_audience: agency staff (Office Directors, Office of Logistics) preparing comments on a draft OMB circular
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare and submit agency comments and implementation suggestions on a draft OMB circular (eliminating free parking for Federal workers), sent to the Office of Logistics for collation into an Agency response by a specified deadline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review attached draft OMB memo
rubrics_metrics.description: Attached hereto is a draft OMB memo concerning President Carter’s decision to eliminate free parking for Federal workers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recipients are expected to read the attached draft memo before preparing comments or suggestions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide any comments
rubrics_metrics.description: We have been asked by the Office of Logistics to forward any comments we might have.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit substantive reactions or concerns about the draft; the memo specifically solicits 'comments' (no further format specified).

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide suggestions for implementing the program
rubrics_metrics.description: Forward any suggestions for implementing the program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In addition to critiques, offer concrete implementation proposals or recommended procedures to operationalize the policy change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Send comments directly to Logistics by the deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Please send your comments direct to Logistics by 18 April.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comments must be sent straight to the Office of Logistics and must meet the specified submission deadline (18 April).

rubrics_metrics.name: Format/submission will be collated into agency response
rubrics_metrics.description: Logistics will then collate any comments into an overall Agency response to OMB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Individual submissions should be suitable for collation into a single agency reply (concise, attributable to office/unit as appropriate); no specific format given, but expect aggregation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution to specified offices/staff
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribution : 1-ea Office Directors/Staffs 1-DDA Chrono *--3r- DDA Subj 1-D/OLL ’ 1- A-EO/DDA
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The memo is circulated to named internal offices and staff—intended recipients include Office Directors, relevant DDA staff, and Office of Logistics distribution points.
